purpose: Read-only decision note providing bounded hardware-hour estimates, licensed engine options, training data boundaries, data retention, and zero-spend default for Owner Review Gate.

defaultPolicy.name: ZERO_SPEND_DEFAULT
defaultPolicy.rationale: In the absence of an explicit signed affirmative owner decision, zero cloud resources may be provisioned, zero third-party APIs called, and zero compute budget spent.

concreteProvisioningOption.name: Isolated Self-Hosted Container on Dedicated GPU Instance
concreteProvisioningOption.architecture: Ephemeral Docker container spun up on-demand; terminates immediately upon job completion with zero standing idle compute.

hardwareTarget.gpu: 1x NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM) or NVIDIA A10G (24GB VRAM)

hardwareCostModel.standingMonthlyIdleCostUsd: $0.00 USD (zero standing instances, container destroyed after job execution)

sfmEngine.name: COLMAP
sfmEngine.provenance: Open-source SfM by Johannes L. Schonberger; source compiled directly in container

gaussianSplattingEngine.name: gsplat / Nerfstudio
gaussianSplattingEngine.provenance: Open-source CUDA rasterization library maintained by Nerfstudio team; no proprietary 3DGS-inria non-commercial restrictions

modelWeights.explanation: Gaussian splatting directly optimizes 3D Gaussians from multi-view camera inputs using gradient descent; zero pre-trained weights or foundational model licenses involved.

preexistingBenchmarkAssets.restriction: Strictly isolated from commercial distribution until owner provides affirmative intellectual property and redistribution attestation.

dataAndRetentionBoundaries.customerDataIsolation: Customer multi-position images ingested solely into tenant-isolated ephemeral workspace.
dataAndRetentionBoundaries.telemetryAndTraining: Zero customer data telemetry, zero sharing with third parties, zero training of foundation models.
dataAndRetentionBoundaries.retentionPolicy: Scratch directory destroyed immediately upon pipeline completion or error via recursive directory wipe.
dataAndRetentionBoundaries.outputArtifacts: Generated SPZ/PLY models stored strictly under customer tenant vault with authenticated cryptographic download tokens.

affirmativeOwnerDecisionRequirements: 1. Explicit selection of reconstruction compute path (Isolated Container vs Managed Cloud vs Deferred).
2. Explicit signed authorization of monthly compute budget ceiling (e.g. $50/mo cap).
3. Affirmative intellectual property attestation for commercial redistribution of Wilo demo booth assets.
